source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Melee weapons carried by this unit's models have their Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1. This is one of the Temple Relics abilities: in your Command phase, if the unit still includes at least one Cenobyte Servitor model, you can pick it, and Chaplain Grimaldus then has it until your next Command phase starts.
